description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data entries across seven distinct task categories within a dataset of 1.4 million open-source distilled reasoning examples, designed to support large language model training. The largest segment, colored red, represents “Math” tasks, comprising 29.3% of the total (410,756 entries). The second-largest, in blue, is “Coding” at 24.3% (339,907 entries), followed by “Information Seeking” in green at 22.2% (311,427 entries). The “Reasoning” category, shown in orange, accounts for 10.4% (145,329 entries). Smaller slices include “Planning” (2.3%, 31,757 entries) in light purple, “Creative Writing” (2.2%, 30,144 entries) in pink, and a combined “Others” category (9.3%, 130,671 entries) in light green. A legend in the upper-left corner matches each category to its color and provides absolute counts. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of Math, Coding, and Information Seeking, while the remaining categories collectively constitute about one-third of the dataset. The segments are arranged clockwise in descending order of proportion, with percentage labels placed adjacent to each slice for clarity.
